notes: [POST /comment] XXE vulnerability (libxmljs.parseXmlString with noent:true). Not BOLA — no object-level access control issue.
evidence: libxmljs.parseXmlString(rawcomment, {noent: true, noblanks: true}); — parses arbitrary XML, no user-object binding.

notes: [POST /save-preference] Insecure Deserialization (node-serialize). Not BOLA — deserializes cookie, no DB query or object-level access.
[POST /disable-totp] SAFE. Uses req.user.username from JWT session for the WHERE clause. No user-controlled object ID.
evidence: Users.update({totpSecret: ''}, {where: {username: req.user.username}}) — ownership enforced via session.

notes: [POST /unlock-secret] NoSQL Injection via $where operator. Not BOLA — queries a shared 'secret' collection, no per-user object access.
[GET /notes/user/:userid] BOLA. Fetches notes by userid from URL path parameter. No check that req.params.userid === req.user.id.
evidence: const userid = req.params.userid; Notes.findAll({where: {userid: userid}}) — attacker supplies arbitrary userid in URL.

notes: [POST /organization/add-user] BOLA. Fetches authenticated user's org but then updates ANY user specified in req.body.user. Attacker can hijack arbitrary users into their organization.
evidence: Users.update({orgname: queryResult.orgname}, {where: {username: req.body.user}}) — target user is attacker-controlled.

notes: [POST /mongodb-notes/show-notes] BOLA. Accepts arbitrary req.body.username and returns all notes for that user from MongoDB. No comparison with req.user.username.
